title: Apollo’s Brightspeed Casts Going Concern Doubt as Revenue Slides
summary: Brightspeed, the broadband provider backed by Apollo Global Management Inc., warned investors that there’s substantial doubt it will be able to continue as a going concern, as it presses ahead with its search for financing to meet looming debt obligations.

title: Waymo Expands Paid Robotaxi Rides to Denver, San Diego and Tampa
summary: Waymo will begin offering paid robotaxi rides to the public in Denver, San Diego, and Tampa, Florida, bringing the number of US cities where its driverless ride-hail service is available to 14.

title: Apple’s Ternus Has ‘Huge Shoes to Fill’ After Cook’s 2,300% Gain
summary: Apple Inc.’s Tim Cook handed over the reins to John Ternus on Tuesday, capping a tenure as chief executive officer that cemented the company as an iconic global brand and turned its stock into one of the most reliable bets.

title: Fervo Signs Geothermal Power Deal With Google for 2028 Launch
summary: Alphabet Inc. has tapped geothermal developer Fervo Energy Co. to provide up to 396 megawatts of power for a prospective data center in Utah beginning in 2028.

title: China Unlikely to Match ASML’s Top Tool in Next Decade, UBS Says
summary: China is unlikely to advance its semiconductor manufacturing capabilities fast enough to develop a viable alternative to ASML Holding NV’s cutting-edge extreme ultraviolet technology within the next decade, UBS Group AG analysts predict.

title: Roku Launches Its First OLED TVs, With Prices Starting at $999
summary: Roku Inc. introduced its first self-branded smart TVs with organic light emitting diode, or OLED, display technology, which will lend the new models greater contrast and punchier black levels than previous first-party Roku TVs.

title: Saudi Video Game Giant Savvy CEO Brian Ward Is Stepping Down
summary: Savvy Games Group Chief Executive Officer Brian Ward, who oversaw the Saudi Arabian government’s $38 billion investment in the video-game industry, is stepping down, according to a message he sent to staff on Tuesday that was reviewed by Bloomberg News.

title: Salesforce Backs Software Firm HiBob at $3.2 Billion Value
summary: Salesforce Inc. is investing in human resources software company HiBob as part of a more than $160 million funding round that values the startup at over $3.2 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Nvidia’s MediaTek Investment Marks the Next AI Chipmaking Champion to Watch
summary: Nvidia and Google are investing in Taiwan’s unheralded chipmaker

title: YouTube Inks Amazon Partnership to Boost Online Shopping Bet
summary: YouTube has tapped Amazon.com Inc. as its newest affiliate partner in YouTube Shopping, part of the video giant’s push to prioritize e-commerce as one of its next big bets.

title: Earnings Make Rising Rates Tolerable for Equities, NewEdge’s Dawson Says
summary: Cameron Dawson, chief investment officer at NewEdge Wealth, suggests waiting for some volatility to come and create better equities buying opportunities as she says, “2Q is likely the peak in earnings growth rate.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Job Risks Spread to PR, Web Development and Hotel Workers
summary: The US job market isn’t improving

title: Felix Pago Raises $200 Million to Expand Into Financial Services
summary: Money-transfer startup Felix Pago raised $200 million to expand beyond remittances and offer services such as lending and savings to Latin American immigrants in the US.

title: Dyson Announces $499 CameraJet Smart Toothbrush With AI, Built-In Camera
summary: Dyson Ltd. introduced a $499 toothbrush that uses artificial intelligence and a built-in camera to give real-time feedback, the latest in a growing subset of gadgets that put AI and video in sometimes unconventional places.

title: China Freezes China Court Freezes Nexperia Assets in Fight Over Dutch Chipmaker
summary: Nexperia BV’s owner Wingtech Technology Co. said a Chinese court froze 2.14 billion yuan ($318 million) worth of assets held by the Dutch chipmaker, the latest in a protracted tussle for control of the company.

title: Deere Launches AI Assistant Named JD to Guide Farmers’ Choices
summary: Farmers are getting some help sorting through the reams of data collected by their high-tech tractors: An AI assistant named JD built into Deere & Co.’s Operations Center mobile application.

title: Shein Finishes Rocky Hong Kong Debut by Nearly Erasing 10% Slump
summary: Shein Global Holdings Ltd. shares pared steep early losses to finish almost unchanged in their Hong Kong debut after a years-long process to an initial public offering that eventually valued the company at a fraction of what it was once worth and still left investors questioning its value as consumer play.

title: Drahi Sells Stake in Vodafone’s German Fiber Venture to SocGen
summary: Societe Generale SA will buy Patrick Drahi’s 50% stake in OXG, a German fiber joint venture with Vodafone Group Plc, as the heavily indebted billionaire continues to sell telecommunication assets.

title: Baidu’s AI Profits to Match Those From Search Soon, CFO Says
summary: Baidu Inc.’s finance chief said the company’s investment in AI could soon generate profits and cash payback on par with those of its legacy search business, justifying a hard-fought transition from its internet roots.

title: MiniMax Eyes AGI Milestone Tied to 1% of Global GDP Output
summary: Chinese AI lab MiniMax Group Inc.’s Co-Founder Yeyi Yun said the milestone for artificial general intelligence will be set by its ability to generate 1% of the global economy.
